review.summary: Phase 00 round 03 is a narrowly-scoped, well-verified fix. I read CLAUDE.md, IDE-WORKFLOW.ar.md, coordinator.ar.md, scope.md, request.json, round-03's codex.md/security.md/remediation.md, all nine round-03 logs, tests.json, git-status.txt, and cross-diffed source-diff.txt against round-02's source-diff.txt (both prior rounds' claude.json verdicts also read). The round-02 approval (session 71bf622f-e7db-46f7-80af-96486ac6c073, verdict approve, verifiedClosed=[GOV-00-EVID-01]) is preserved unchanged in docs/phases/00/round-02/claude.json and docs/phases/status.json still shows rounds:[1,2] (round 3 not yet counted, consistent with pre-import state). Comparing every scripts/governance/*.mjs git-object index hash between round-02 and round-03's source-diff.txt, only scripts/governance/completion.mjs (64dbab2->c9e7db2) and completion.test.mjs (02d6eca->f76dc1f) changed; coordinator.mjs, coordinator-process.mjs, gate.mjs, phase-gate.mjs, required-checks.mjs, cli-review.mjs, common.mjs, reference-e2e.mjs, reference-playwright.config.ts, browser-tests/reference-motion.spec.ts and all other *.test.mjs are byte-identical to the already-approved round-02 source, and reference/prototype again shows zero diff against main (GOV-00-01 holds). I independently confirmed the described defect and fix in the actual code: round-02's github() built `repos/${repository}/${path}`, which for the root-lookup call `api('')` produced `repos/nextleapgit/specialsite/` (trailing slash, the documented cause of GitHub's 404). The current completion.mjs:59 now builds `repos/${repository}${path ? \`/${path}\` : ''}`, correctly omitting the slash only when path is empty while preserving it for every subpath (branches/main/protection, pulls/N, actions/...), matching codex.md's and security.md's description exactly. completion.test.mjs adds a genuinely new test (absent from round-02) 'GitHub transport uses the accepted repository endpoint without a trailing slash and preserves pagination' that asserts the exact three built paths and that pagination/stdio/windowsHide/execute-injection-only-in-tests properties hold; the optional `execute` parameter defaults to execFileSync at every production call site, so no test-only bypass leaks into production behavior. logs/governance.txt shows this new test passing alongside all 90 previously-passing governance tests (91/91 total, up from round-02's 90), and logs/unit-component.txt (72/72) and logs/e2e-accessibility-visual.txt (32/32, including the two round-02 motion tests) match codex.md's claimed 195-test total exactly, with all nine tests.json checks at exitCode 0 on sourceDigest 5ff47c9221480f6b492fac9c3fd4eac0b6c187c4d254f5034acc1d81f95f89a8. dependency-audit.txt shows zero vulnerabilities and secret-scan.txt shows zero findings across 294 scanned files. Live remote evidence in docs/phases/00/attempts/rest-endpoint-correction/pre-review-evidence.json (top-level sourceDigest matches request.json's exactly) shows the repository is public, branch protection is intact (enforce_admins, strict checks bound to app_id 15368 for all three required contexts, no force-push/deletion, conversation resolution required, no review-bypass allowances), the PR (#1) is still open/unmerged, and both the push run (36340397396) and PR run (36340400170) on head commit d323d4d1d025468503815c7fe9ecee039554321d show reference-quality and governance-security as conclusion:success; phase-evidence fails only at the 'Require current independent review and local evidence' step, which per the staged-review contract in CLAUDE.md is the expected pre-approval state, not a defect or approval blocker. No merge has occurred (pullRequest.merged:false, docs/phases/status.json unmodified apart from rounds). The prior round-01 finding GOV-00-EVID-01 remains correctly closed (already reflected in round-02's verifiedClosed) and is not reopened by anything in this round's source or evidence; I found no new open defect in completion.mjs, completion.test.mjs, or any other file in this round's scope. Merge itself, merged-check verification and phase completion recording remain outstanding post-approval steps per the staged contract, not prerequisites for this source approval.
